messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync 30  — are we green for the marketplace go-live dry run tomorrow? Need yes/no for press embargo, blog assets, listing copy, SI note, and partner logos.
Eli (Marketing): Press embargo set. Blog is final except OG image and hero variants. Will upload by 14:00 PT.
Jess (Partner Ops): Partner logo pending final comms approval (ETA ~18 hrs). We have permission to use the neutral line: "in collaboration with our hardware partners" if logo delayed.
Sam (Eng): Staging landing passes perf tests. CDN and cache headers configured. Two asks: 1) confirm hero images, 2) include sandbox curl example (no real keys).
Nora (Design): Uploaded hero_desktop_final.png + hero_mobile_final.png to shared drive and posted links in the thread.
Eli (Marketing): Using sandbox snippet: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_SANDBOX_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate — will ensure no prod keys in screenshots.
Ravi (Legal): Reviewed joint announcement; small language tweak for SI credentialing. I commented in the doc and approve neutral partner phrasing.
Maya (Partnerships): Dry run plan: Mon 16:00 PT, 15-min walk through (press timing, landing CTA, purchase sandbox), 5-min SI handoff. Jess to invite partners.
Jess (Partner Ops): Invites sent to SI reps and partner comms.
Sam (Eng): Cutover smoke checklist: verify listing links, test sandbox purchase, validate hero assets, check monitoring, confirm fallback model route.
Eli (Marketing): Also verify social card previews and AMP metadata in the dry run.
Maya (Partnerships): Final ask: drop pricing table + hero images + logo decision by EOD tomorrow. If all green we keep embargo as scheduled. Thanks! :tada:
